units.source_text: 寺庙的人给老师前往的地方挂了电话。

en.t: Someone from the temple called the place where the teacher had gone.

units.source_text: 对方回话说：老师再过约奖一个钟头就会回去。

en.t: The person on the other end replied that the teacher would be back in about another hour.

units.source_text: 禅海和尚这次上京都，打算在鹿苑寺泊一两宿。

en.t: This time, Priest Zenkai was going up to Kyoto and intended to spend one or two nights at Rokuonji.
